terminal_predicates: (A Replay Result is successful only when an independently executed Probe verification is present and passes.) AND (A non-matching target yields a rejection terminal state and zero downstream processing events.) AND (A verdict is terminally valid only if source identity and execution evidence validate and narrative text contributes no decision input.) AND (All aggregate records have a terminal state, no execution exceeds bounds, and equivalent executions produce the same terminal state.) AND (For every Consumer Manifest entry, all applicable route transitions have completed and each has a recorded post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; aggregate completed transitions equals aggregate applicable transitions (100%).) AND (No success verdict exists unless identity and execution facts are both current and independently verifiable.) AND (Pass only when all bound identities match and fresh terminal verdict equals the pinned reference; otherwise terminal status is stale or execution-failed.) AND (Replay success is publishable only when validator_capability verification independently passes and matches the Replay Result identity.) AND (Success can be emitted only when the independently recomputed snapshot identity and verification status match the Replay Result binding.) AND (Terminal only when elapsed time is recorded for each aggregate, is at or below its bound for success, and timeout or budget exhaustion is terminal non-success.) AND (Terminal only when every ambiguous identity or execution input yields deterministic non-success and none yields accepted success.) AND (Terminal only when every skipped-Consumer case is explicitly rejected or non-success and no skipped case can produce accepted success.) AND (当 evidence identity 已用于其他 case 或不新鲜时，success 必须为 false/rejected。) AND (成功结果仅当身份与执行事实都存在、匹配且验证通过；否则终态必须为 rejected/non-success。) AND (所有 success Replay Result 均有独立 target_verification.status=passed 且 identity_match=true。)

(A machine-readable result lists exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases and validation succeeds.) AND (A replay result cannot be successful unless its separately evaluated Consumer verification is present and passes.) AND (A success verdict is terminal only when output verification is independently asserted and matches the emitted output identity.) AND (Escaping input yields a non-success terminal result.) AND (No candidate with missing, unknown, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable required identity or execution facts is accepted as successful.) AND (The negative selector reports an unsupported-target denial and no replay execution result is emitted.) AND (The selected Toolchain unit test proves that an illegal target returns nonzero before validator success can occur.) AND (The selected Toolchain unit test proves that an invalid package, including one paired with an always-success validator, cannot produce an accepted success result.) AND (Validation passes only when an independent effective-inspection assertion is present and matches the inspected package identity.) AND (独立身份摘要与规范化目标路径均经重新计算并与请求绑定一致，否则验证失败。) AND (矩阵汇总验证命令执行完成，结构化结果明确包含复制证据拒绝和 FR-8，状态为 invalid，且不存在 valid 结论。)

(A runtime snapshot with an unknown required fact yields a rejection or non-success result and cannot authorize success.) AND (The boundary guard rejects overwrite and out-of-bound writes, and the authorized capture yields only an append at the declared boundary.)

(A separate validator invocation emits an independently attributable support-policy result required for acceptance.) AND (The FR-3 compatibility check emits an independently derived result and the negative selector fails when that check is absent.)

(A successful replay exposes a passing non-authority-binding verification outcome, while a missing or altered binding makes the replay verification fail.) AND (All six case records show Stable-subject execution and equality of pre-execution and post-execution Stable identity/content.) AND (No exhausted time or output budget can produce success, pending status, or an ambiguous terminal classification.) AND (Replay succeeds only when post-sequence route identity, verdict, and diagnostic outputs exactly match the captured baseline; any mismatch is a failed result.) AND (Replay validation passes only when the successful Replay Result contains a distinct passing command-verification record with the declared native command identity; missing, aggregate-only, or mismatched command verification fails validation.) AND (Support is accepted only when Windows is explicitly identified, handled by the declared branch, and not rejected solely due to platform identity.) AND (The aggregate is successful only when evidence contains both subject executions for each of six matrix cases; any missing pair is terminally failed.) AND (The evaluator emits an explicit failed terminal classification for the infrastructure-failure false-negative case.) AND (The existing replay selector observes a detached-negative receipt entry with a nonzero exit result and process identity distinct from the replay runner; an in-process, simulated, or zero-exit negative Probe fails the selector.) AND (The replay command reports an invalid aggregate when the Matrix Case evidence target differs from the declared target, without a valid aggregate status.) AND (The replay command returns an unsuccessful aggregate for the adversarial dependency selector, and neither the case nor aggregate reports success.) AND (The replay command returns an unsuccessful aggregate for the stale-input selector, and no case or aggregate field reports success.) AND (成功结果包含独立 dependency verification outcome、每项依赖证据且验证器通过。)
(Acceptance is terminal only when missing_callers and orphan_manifest_entries are empty for all three scopes.) AND (三个 occurrence 的每一项都满足 counterexample XOR explicit absence；否则校验失败。)

(Aggregate status equals invalid whenever required matrix evidence is absent or unexecuted.) AND (All applicable Consumers restore Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.) AND (For any required stale matrix evidence, validator exits with an invalid aggregate status and identifies the stale artifact; no valid aggregate is emitted.) AND (Fresh-checkout semantic verdict equals the reference verdict and pinned-input provenance is complete.) AND (The fresh-checkout run emits a coverage result and equality assertion against the pinned reference; the altered-input selector produces a deterministic failure.) AND (仅当 fresh-checkout identities、pinned inputs、重建结果及 reference Exact Cover 全部匹配且回执可追溯时终止为成功，否则为 stale/evidence-invalid/coverage failure。) AND (存在任一基础设施失败或不可执行 case 时，且仅此时，aggregate terminal status 为 invalid 并包含对应 case identity/reason；不得输出 valid。) AND (每个适用 Consumer 均有四步有序真实调用记录，且最终 route identity、verdict、diagnostic 与 Prior baseline 相同。)

(Closure is accepted only when all required semantic dependency bindings are independently verified as current and consistent.) AND (The route is valid only if the historical and candidate native command projections are identical; any substitution is rejected.)

(Evaluation emits rejected-success for the adversarial target case and the negative selector exits as a failure.) AND (Isolation verification passes only when mutations remain local to the originating entity and evidence identities remain distinct.) AND (Terminal only when every inventory obligation has all required witnesses, every witness references an inventory obligation, and the report states zero orphans.) AND (The complete inventory result reports 100-percent bidirectional Exact Cover and any member missing either direction fails validation.) AND (The structural evaluation reports zero orphan nodes, while the orphan-node negative selector fails.)

(Every launched process terminates within configured budgets with a stable terminal classification; budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.) AND (Probe evidence is valid only when input binding and output binding carry the same execution identity as the process invocation.) AND (只有存在独立子进程 identity、完整 input/target/command/output bindings 且 worker 成功退出时才可判定成功；启动、导入、超时或缺失观察均失败。)

(Evidence is accepted only when the referenced content bytes match the recorded digest and inspected content.) AND (Verification passes iff observed_count equals manifest_count and every entry has baseline_match=true.)

(Exactly the current Acceptance lifecycle owner can publish acceptance-passed; all non-owner attempts are denied and the authorization set is empty for them.) AND (The validator succeeds only when every enumerated Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifact is readable, structurally parsed, and has authorization_set=[]; any non-empty, missing, malformed, or omitted artifact fails.)

(For every Matrix Case, Stable and Candidate each have a fixture/state assignment and the two assignments are distinct.) AND (汇总结果为 invalid，missing case 集合非空，不存在 valid aggregate 发布。) AND (聚合结果 status 为 failed 且 missing_cases 覆盖每个缺失必需执行。)

(Replay is accepted only when fresh-checkout canonical result and all result-determining snapshot inputs match the recorded result.) AND (Validation proves the result references a complete Current Snapshot and rejects absent or partial bindings.) AND (两类受支持路由均可达并返回成功，且每个结果含 effective inspected content 标识。)

(The evaluator returns a failure result whenever the always-success false-negative case is encountered.) AND (每个 evidence identity 至多映射一个 Matrix Case；存在重复时 aggregate.status 必须为 invalid 且含重复诊断。) AND (规范化 before 与 after membership 的路径序列及计数逐项相等，且差异集合为空。)

(The report computes orphan_count equal to zero only when every atomic obligation has bidirectional coverage and required witnesses; otherwise validation fails.) AND (The structured result contains a non-success decision for the unexecuted case and an explicit unexecuted-case rejection reason.)

(The validator source path and content digest have an independently produced pass record; otherwise evaluation remains blocked.) AND (Validator exits success only when both mapping directions contain no unmatched entries and all three named consumer scopes are present.) AND (Validator output contains an approved repository-relative current authority, a deterministic rejection for every user-profile candidate, and no profile path in the selected authority field.) AND (Verification report confirms exactly three required seed occurrences, each unique and complete; any duplicate or missing provenance causes deterministic failure.) AND (added_paths=[] 且 removed_paths=[]，并且每条历史路径按 repository-relative 规范精确相等。) AND (foreign-authority 输入 success_accepted 必须为 false，failure_reason == foreign-authority。) AND (仅当三个 named occurrences 各自唯一、命名正确且显式包含 missing_labels 字段时通过；任一缺失、重复或未命名记录终止为失败。)

(Validation passes only when evidence is appended and all frozen historical paths, membership, and bytes are unchanged.) AND (Validation succeeds only when all six Matrix Cases have both Stable and Candidate attributed records.)
A candidate delta containing a frozen historical path rename, move, deletion, or reassignment is rejected; an append-only allowed delta does not alter those paths.
A machine validator links each verdict to current source identity and a real command execution record.
Every aggregate terminal record has emitted_output_count <= output_bound; any bound exhaustion yields unsuccessful status and a deterministic reason.
Every historical artifact's post-repair bytes equal its pre-repair bytes; any mismatch is a terminal validation failure.
For every one of the six Matrix Cases, Candidate pre- and post-execution identity or content digests are equal and attributable in the emitted evidence; otherwise validation fails.
Independent verification confirms candidate-external trust, and a candidate whose trust cannot be independently established is rejected.
Independent verification report exists, includes source/content rule checks, and passes only when all required FR-3 validator semantics are present.
Manifest validation reports exactly three named occurrences, each with an approved non-baseline classification, and the negative selector fails for missing, baseline, or unapproved classification.
Pass only when old entries' bytes, order, and membership are unchanged and new entries form a suffix; any prefix mutation fails.
Pass only when terminal completion is observed within timeout and output cap; timeout, overrun, or missing terminal state fails.
Pass only when the machine-readable decision proves historical evidence contributed no authority; fail on any sole-historical authorization.
RMAP-S2 校验成功并输出三项种子各 count=1、FR-6 字段完整；任一缺失、重复或字段缺失均返回失败。
Target resolution terminates closed with a rejection outcome whenever the target is missing.
The preservation validator reports equal before/after bytes for every frozen artifact and fails when any frozen artifact is changed.
The selected Toolchain unit test proves that a changed result-determining snapshot identity cannot leave the replay result reusable or successful.
The selected runtime test proves that a process attempting excess output cannot produce unbounded artifacts or a successful terminal result.
Validation succeeds only if exactly three named occurrences each include non-empty applicability.
adversarial case outcome 明确为 rejected-success 且 success_accepted=false；否则治理检查失败。
bidirectional == true、orphan_nodes == []，且五类 node_type_coverage 均 complete。
case 数量恰为六、每 case 有输入记录且输入集合基数为六；否则 aggregate fail。
verdict 已绑定当前源身份和真实执行事件，或被明确拒绝。
任何适用平台行为都必须有可定位声明；缺失声明不得通过。
前后规范化 tracked membership 集合完全相等且无 membership diff；否则终止为失败。
所有 evidence 引用的 owner 与当前实体及 rollback stage 完全匹配，且跨域引用集合为空；否则失败。
替换目标被明确拒绝，后续处理调用数为零，且验证器返回 target-binding-failure。
错误标签存在时 aggregate_status == invalid 且包含对应 invalid_reason。
验证器确认进程边界存在且输入绑定标识等于输出绑定标识并对应本次执行；任一缺失即失败。
